clips.title: The story
paras: An intercepted dispatch from gnoll raiders in Elwynn Forest lays out when gold shipments leave the abandoned mines. It is addressed to a figure called 'The Collector' and points to an organized operation near Stormwind's garrison.

Riverpaw gnoll packs in western Elwynn Forest carry more than furs and crude weapons. Among them, a parchment called the Gold Pickup Schedule lays out dates and times for gold taken from local mines. The intercepted note directs each shipment to an overseer identified only as 'The Collector.'

Marshal Dughan hears the news at the Lion's Pride Inn and learns that gold is still being mined and moved. Official mines across Elwynn have been closed for months because of gnoll attacks, kobold infestations, and roaming bandits. Gnolls carrying shipping schedules point to an organized criminal network stealing the kingdom's wealth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.
From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.
This sounds important. You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!
Let me see that note you have...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. Thank you for the schedule. It will help us solve this mystery.
